Model, validation, helpers
```go
package api

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"net/http"

	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

// Product matches the provided JSON schema.
type Product struct {
	ID          string   `json:"id" db:"id"`
	Name        string   `json:"name" validate:"required"`
	Description *string  `json:"description,omitempty"`
	Price       float64  `json:"price,omitempty" validate:"gte=0"`
	Stock       *int     `json:"stock,omitempty" validate:"gte=0"`
}

// Bind/validate helper for incoming payloads.
var validate = validator.New()

func (p *Product) Validate() error {
	return validate.Struct(p)
}

// HTTP helpers
func writeJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, v interface{}) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(v)
}

type apiError struct {
	Error string `json:"error"`
}

func writeError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, err error) {
	writeJSON(w, status, apiError{Error: err.Error()})
}
```

Repository interface + in-memory implementation (for demo/testing)
```go
package api

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
)

var ErrNotFound = errors.New("not found")

type ProductStore interface {
	Create(ctx context.Context, p *Product) error
	Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*Product, error)
	Update(ctx context.Context, p *Product) error
	Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error
	List(ctx context.Context, limit, offset int) ([]*Product, error)
}

type MemStore struct {
	mu sync.RWMutex
	m  map[string]*Product
}

func NewMemStore() *MemStore {
	return &MemStore{m: make(map[string]*Product)}
}

func (s *MemStore) Create(ctx context.Context, p *Product) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if p.ID == "" {
		p.ID = uuid.New().String()
	}
	s.m[p.ID] = clone(p)
	return nil
}

func (s *MemStore) Get(ctx context.Context, id string) (*Product, error) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	if p, ok := s.m[id]; ok {
		return clone(p), nil
	}
	return nil, ErrNotFound
}

func (s *MemStore) Update(ctx context.Context, p *Product) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.m[p.ID]; !ok {
		return ErrNotFound
	}
	s.m[p.ID] = clone(p)
	return nil
}

func (s *MemStore) Delete(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	if _, ok := s.m[id]; !ok {
		return ErrNotFound
	}
	delete(s.m, id)
	return nil
}

func (s *MemStore) List(ctx context.Context, limit, offset int) ([]*Product, error) {
	s.mu.RLock()
	defer s.mu.RUnlock()
	out := make([]*Product, 0, len(s.m))
	for _, p := range s.m {
		out = append(out, clone(p))
	}
	// simple offset/limit without ordering (for demo)
	if offset > len(out) {
		return []*Product{}, nil
	}
	end := len(out)
	if limit > 0 && offset+limit < end {
		end = offset + limit
	}
	return out[offset:end], nil
}

func clone(p *Product) *Product {
	if p == nil {
		return nil
	}
	cp := *p
	if p.Description != nil {
		desc := *p.Description
		cp.Description = &desc
	}
	if p.Stock != nil {
		s := *p.Stock
		cp.Stock = &s
	}
	return &cp
}
```

Handlers
```go
package api

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

// ProductHandler groups dependencies.
type ProductHandler struct {
	Store ProductStore
}

func NewProductHandler(store ProductStore) *ProductHandler {
	return &ProductHandler{Store: store}
}

// POST /products
func (h *ProductHandler) Create(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	var in Product
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&in); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	// server assigns ID if absent
	if in.ID != "" {
		if _, err := uuid.Parse(in.ID); err != nil {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("invalid id"))
			return
		}
	}
	if err := in.Validate(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	if in.Price < 0 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("price must be >= 0"))
		return
	}
	if in.Stock != nil && *in.Stock < 0 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("stock must be >= 0"))
		return
	}

	if err := h.Store.Create(r.Context(), &in); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusCreated, in)
}

// GET /products/{id}
func (h *ProductHandler) Get(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "id")
	p, err := h.Store.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err)
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, p)
}

// GET /products?limit=&offset=
func (h *ProductHandler) List(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	q := r.URL.Query()
	limit, _ := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("limit"))
	offset, _ := strconv.Atoi(q.Get("offset"))

	products, err := h.Store.List(r.Context(), limit, offset)
	if err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, products)
}

// PUT /products/{id} - full replace
func (h *ProductHandler) Update(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "id")
	var in Product
	if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&in); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	in.ID = id
	if err := in.Validate(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	if in.Price < 0 || (in.Stock != nil && *in.Stock < 0) {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("price/stock must be >= 0"))
		return
	}
	if err := h.Store.Update(r.Context(), &in); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err)
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, in)
}

// PATCH /products/{id} - partial update
func (h *ProductHandler) Patch(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "id")
	// decode into map to allow partial fields
	var patch map[string]interface{}
	body, _ := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
	if len(body) == 0 {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("empty body"))
		return
	}
	if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &patch); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}

	// fetch existing
	p, err := h.Store.Get(r.Context(), id)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err)
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}

	// apply patch (explicitly handle allowed fields)
	if v, ok := patch["name"]; ok {
		if s, ok := v.(string); ok && s != "" {
			p.Name = s
		} else {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("invalid name"))
			return
		}
	}
	if v, ok := patch["description"]; ok {
		if v == nil {
			p.Description = nil
		} else if s, ok := v.(string); ok {
			p.Description = &s
		} else {
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("invalid description"))
			return
		}
	}
	if v, ok := patch["price"]; ok {
		switch t := v.(type) {
		case float64:
			if t < 0 {
				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("price must be >= 0"))
				return
			}
			p.Price = t
		case int:
			if float64(t) < 0 {
				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("price must be >= 0"))
				return
			}
			p.Price = float64(t)
		default:
			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("invalid price"))
			return
		}
	}
	if v, ok := patch["stock"]; ok {
		if v == nil {
			p.Stock = nil
		} else {
			// JSON numbers come as float64
			if f, ok := v.(float64); ok {
				n := int(f)
				if n < 0 {
					writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("stock must be >= 0"))
					return
				}
				p.Stock = &n
			} else {
				writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("invalid stock"))
				return
			}
		}
	}

	// validate name presence
	if err := p.Validate(); err != nil {
		writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}

	if err := h.Store.Update(r.Context(), p); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err)
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	writeJSON(w, http.StatusOK, p)
}

// DELETE /products/{id}
func (h *ProductHandler) Delete(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	id := chi.URLParam(r, "id")
	if err := h.Store.Delete(r.Context(), id); err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
			writeError(w, http.StatusNotFound, err)
			return
		}
		writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err)
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}
```

Router wiring (main.go)
```go
package main

import (
	"log"
	"net/http"
	"time"

	"your/module/path/api"

	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5/middleware"
)

func main() {
	store := api.NewMemStore()
	h := api.NewProductHandler(store)

	r := chi.NewRouter()
	r.Use(middleware.RequestID)
	r.Use(middleware.RealIP)
	r.Use(middleware.Logger)
	r.Use(middleware.Recoverer)
	r.Use(middleware.Timeout(30 * time.Second))

	r.Route("/products", func(r chi.Router) {
		r.Post("/", h.Create)
		r.Get("/", h.List)
		r.Route("/{id}", func(r chi.Router) {
			r.Get("/", h.Get)
			r.Put("/", h.Update)
			r.Patch("/", h.Patch)
			r.Delete("/", h.Delete)
		})
	})

	log.Println("listening :8080")
	if err := http.ListenAndServe(":8080", r); err != nil {
		log.Fatal(err)
	}
}
```

- Consider OpenAPI, request/response DTOs to avoid over-posting.
- Implement pagination ordering, filtering, and optimistic locking for concurrent updates.
- Add authentication/authorization and rate limiting as required.
